payload.reason: The evidence provides specific measures and methods used to evaluate the quality of a Q&A platform, particularly Zhihu Live, including data-driven approaches and statistical metrics.

claims.text: Quality evaluation of Zhihu Live is conducted using a data-driven approach that includes data collection, cleaning, normalization, and predictive analysis.
Mean Absolute Error (MAE) and Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) are used to estimate the performance of learning algorithms for quality evaluation.
The presence of badges for speakers, indicating their expertise, slightly influences the quality ratings of Zhihu Lives.
The review count and statistical measures (mean, variance) are used to assess the quality of Zhihu Lives, indicating that most are of high quality.
